# PresentMon CSV fixtures

These are **synthetic** rows in the column formats documented by the official
PresentMon console README at tags v2.3.1 and v2.3.0. They are not a real game
capture, hardware validation, overhead measurement, or anti-cheat compatibility
evidence. A physical capture remains a separate validation step.

- `synthetic-2.3.1-default.csv`: representative default v2.3.1 names.
- `synthetic-2.3.1-v2.csv`: older v2 metrics selected by `--v2_metrics`.

Sources:
https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/blob/v2.3.1/README-ConsoleApplication.md
https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/blob/v2.3.0/README-ConsoleApplication.md
